tools.name: vigil_info
tools.description: Service description, the Ed25519 signing pubkey to verify receipts against, current chain head, and free-tier limits. No key required.

tools.name: vigil_register
tools.description: Create a key. Returns a bearer key shown ONCE — store it; it is your only identity. No email, no account. Starts on the free tier.

tools.name: vigil_pricing
tools.description: The plans and per-tier limits (free, dev, pro). No key required.

tools.name: vigil_usage
tools.description: Your current tier, its limits, and how much you've used today. Requires your key.

tools.name: vigil_notarize
tools.description: Notarize work: POST the sha256 (64 hex chars) of anything and get back an Ed25519-signed, timestamped, hash-chained, serial-numbered receipt. The proof of 'when' is the position in the public chain, not the timestamp string. Free tier: 10/day.

tools.name: vigil_get_receipt
tools.description: Fetch a receipt by serial number. Public — anyone can read any receipt.

tools.name: vigil_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a receipt's hash and Ed25519 signature against a pubkey you trust (from vigil_info, confirmed out-of-band). If you omit pubkey_hex it self-attests against THIS server's own key and flags self_attested=true — that is a convenience, not independent proof.

tools.name: vigil_chain
tools.description: Read a range of receipts to audit chain continuity. Max 1000 per call.

tools.name: vigil_set_watchdog
tools.description: Arm a dead-man switch. Register an interval and an https webhook; then call vigil_heartbeat before each interval elapses. Miss one and Vigil POSTs a signed 'absence' payload to your webhook once. Free tier: 1 watchdog.

tools.name: vigil_heartbeat
tools.description: 'Still alive.' Reset a watchdog's timer. Call this at least once per interval.

tools.name: vigil_watchdog_status
tools.description: Read a watchdog's state: interval, last beat, whether it is overdue, fired, or exhausted.

tools.name: vigil_delete_watchdog
tools.description: Remove a watchdog.

tools.name: vigil_grant_lease
tools.description: Grant a short-lived, Ed25519-signed LEASE authorizing an agent to perform an action until it expires. A customer-run gateway verifies the lease offline (fail-closed) before letting the action through. This is the guard on a money/data-moving action. Free tier: 1 active lease (guarded agent).

tools.name: vigil_renew_lease
tools.description: Extend a lease with a fresh signed token and new expiry. Renewing is how a healthy agent keeps acting; stop renewing (or revoke) and it lapses.

tools.name: vigil_revoke_lease
tools.description: Revoke a lease. A compliant v2 gateway refuses the old offline token at recheck_by_ms (at most 30 seconds after issue/renewal), or earlier if it polls revocation. Revocation is not instantaneous.

tools.name: vigil_lease_status
tools.description: Public status of a lease (active / expired / revoked). What a gateway polls for revocation. No key required.

tools.name: vigil_verify_lease
tools.description: Offline, FAIL-CLOSED check of a lease token against a pinned pubkey (defaults to this server's key). Returns allow=true only if the signature verifies and the lease has not expired. A gateway should also poll status for revocation.

tools.name: vigil_leases
tools.description: List your leases and their states.

tools.name: vigil_anchors
tools.description: Public timestamp submissions to OpenTimestamps calendars. A submission is pending, not an independently verified Bitcoin confirmation. No key required.

tools.name: vigil_anchor
tools.description: PRO: anchor the current chain head to OpenTimestamps on demand (the chain is auto-anchored every few hours regardless).

tools.name: vigil_journal_put
tools.description: Store an opaque blob under a slug (overwrites). Encrypt client-side: the server stores exactly the bytes supplied and cannot enforce client encryption. Send bytes as base64. Free tier: 4 slots, 64KB each.

tools.name: vigil_journal_get
tools.description: Fetch a journal blob by slug. Returns base64 (decrypt client-side).

tools.name: vigil_journal_list
tools.description: List your journal slots (slug, size, last-updated).

tools.name: vigil_journal_delete
tools.description: Delete a journal slot.

tools.name: vigil_revoke_key
tools.description: Revoke your own key. It stops authenticating immediately. Irreversible.

tools.name: vigil_verify_source
tools.description: Paid source-local verification with exact evidence and signed receipt. Does not establish absolute truth. Read price and payment requirements before authorizing; retry with the same vigil/idempotency-key metadata and payment proof.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "vigil_register" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Create a key. Returns a bearer key shown ONCE — store it; it is your only identity. No email, no account. Starts on the free tier.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vigil_notarize · Private data: vigil_renew_lease, vigil_revoke_lease, vigil_verify_lease · Public sink: vigil_register, vigil_notarize, vigil_set_watchdog, vigil_journal_put · Destructive: vigil_heartbeat, vigil_delete_watchdog, vigil_grant_lease, vigil_journal_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vigil_notarize · Private data: vigil_renew_lease, vigil_revoke_lease, vigil_verify_lease · Public sink: vigil_register, vigil_notarize, vigil_set_watchdog, vigil_journal_put · Destructive: vigil_heartbeat, vigil_delete_watchdog, vigil_grant_lease, vigil_journal_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
